Gukesh is one of the top players in the world of chess! He is going to be playing at the Candidates tournament in a few months from now. Just 17 years of age, it is very interesting to see how this youngster lives his life. We visited his home in Chennai and we get a glimpse of his room in this video. But more importantly we get an insight into how Gukesh lives his life. We think he lives like a chess monk - simple living - practices chess, lives books, focusses on fitness and has a bed to take rest. Simple living, high thinking! Let us know if you too think the same! :)
